newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cert coffee stocks up 10,250 bags Dec 13 week.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cert coffee stocks up 10,250 bags Dec 13 week.

text.p: U.S. certified coffee stocks rose by 10,250 60-kg bags in the week ended December 13, to 12,571 bags, the Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange reported on Monday.
In addition, 11,000 bags of coffee were certified for delivery at Miami between December 14-16, after the close of the weekly reporting period.
A further 9,000 bags of coffee were pending grading at warehouses in Miami, New Orleans and New York.

The bulk of the increase this week came from the certification of Guatemalan coffee at Miami. Some 12,250 bags of Guatemalan beans were certified as of last Friday, while an additional 5,500 bags from Guatemala were graded over the weekend.
